exclusions_of_note.name: Named Driver Exclusion — Malina Trujillo
exclusions_of_note.impact: Total exclusion of Liability, Medical Payments, and Physical Damage for any accident or loss involving Malina Trujillo operating any covered auto. Only UM/UIM is preserved (her recovery if injured by an uninsured third party). If Trujillo is still employed and has any vehicle access — formal or informal — every shift creates uninsured exposure. NO other policy in the program will pick this up; the Umbrella follows form to underlying which means if the underlying excludes, the umbrella excludes. Verify employment status urgently.

exclusions_of_note.name: Pollution Exclusion (CA 00 01 §B.11)
exclusions_of_note.impact: Standard auto pollution exclusion bars coverage for pollutants being transported, handled, or in transit. Carve-out for fuel/lubricants/exhaust gases needed for normal operation. Cargo pollution is not covered — a Contractors Pollution Liability or Environmental Liability policy would be needed if the client transports any chemicals, inks (election ballot printing operations may use specialty inks), or hazardous materials.

exclusions_of_note.name: Care, Custody or Control Exclusion (CA 00 01 §B.6)
exclusions_of_note.impact: Property in the insured's care/custody/control is not covered for property damage. For an election services company hauling ballots, voting equipment, or county-owned property, damage to that property in transit is NOT covered by Auto Liability. Inland Marine / Motor Truck Cargo coverage is needed.

exclusions_of_note.name: Handling of Property / Loading & Unloading (CA 00 01 §B.7)
exclusions_of_note.impact: Coverage cuts off before the auto receives the property and after delivery. Bodily injury or property damage during loading/unloading at the staging area before the auto is involved is not covered — General Liability would respond.

exclusions_of_note.name: Handling of Property by Mechanical Device (CA 00 01 §B.8)
exclusions_of_note.impact: Coverage excluded unless the mechanical device is attached to the covered auto. A hand truck is the only allowed exception. Powered pallet jacks or similar devices used outside the auto are not covered.

exclusions_of_note.name: Audio/Visual/Data Electronic Equipment Sublimit
exclusions_of_note.impact: $500 sublimit for any electronic equipment (other than equipment necessary for normal auto operation or sound reproduction) installed in or removable from the covered auto. For an election services company that transports ballot scanners, tabulators, laptops, or other valuable hardware in covered autos, $500 is materially inadequate. Exposure beyond $500 is uninsured under Auto. Inland Marine schedule is the proper home for this equipment.

exclusions_of_note.name: Hired Auto Physical Damage Sublimit
exclusions_of_note.impact: Capped at $50,000 per accident. Adequate for sedans/vans but inadequate for box trucks, sprinter vans, or specialty cargo vehicles that may be rented during peak election season. Loss of use limited to $1,000/accident over 7 days.

exclusions_of_note.name: Loss of Property in Transit / Cargo
exclusions_of_note.impact: No cargo coverage on this Auto policy. Election ballots, voting equipment, county property in transit are uninsured for damage in transit. Recommend Motor Truck Cargo or Inland Marine coverage given the operational profile of transporting ballots and equipment to/from county sites in 31 states.
